senses.gloss:
नेद् 1. नेद् or नेत्, ind. (fr. न + इद्, and
regarded in the Pada-pāṭha as two words), Ved. not,
[]
not indeed (Sāy. = नैव); that not; (see Pāṇ.
VIII. 1, 30; cf. Zend noiḍ, ‘not.’)

नेद् 2. नेद् [cf. rt. 1. निद्], cl. 1. P. नेदति,
&c., to censure, blame; to be near; to go.

नेदय (fr. नेद, see नेदिष्ठ), Nom. P.
नेदयति, &c., to bring near.

नेदयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing near, approxi-
mating.

नेदिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of नेद which is
substituted for अन्तिक, near; probably allied to नद्-
ध fr. rt. 1. नह्), the nearest, next, very near;
(अम्), ind. very nearly, next, in the first place; (आत्),
ind. from the neighbourhood; (अस्), m. Alangium
Hexapetalum; N. of a son of Manu; [cf. Zend
nazdista.]
—नेदिष्ठ-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. the
nearest of all.

नेदिष्ठिन्, ई, इनी, इ, very near, very nearly
related.

नेदीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of नेद which
is substituted for अन्तिक), nearer, very near, as
near as possible.
